xqlStages.name: alter
xqlStages.description: Changes values of an existing field or creates a new one using functions

xqlStages.name: arrayexpand
xqlStages.description: Expands multi-value array fields into separate events

xqlStages.name: bin
xqlStages.description: Groups events by quantity (number) or time span (date type)

xqlStages.name: call
xqlStages.description: References a predefined query from the Query Library

xqlStages.name: comp
xqlStages.description: Calculates statistics (aggregations) over groups of rows
xqlStages.exampleUsage: comp count() as total by src_ip

xqlStages.name: config
xqlStages.description: Configures query behaviour (case_sensitive, timeframe, max_runtime_minutes). Must be the first stage

xqlStages.name: dedup
xqlStages.description: Removes records with duplicate values

xqlStages.name: fields
xqlStages.description: Defines fields returned in the result set. Supports wildcards and exclusion with -

xqlStages.name: filter
xqlStages.description: Narrows down results using boolean expressions

xqlStages.name: getrole
xqlStages.description: Enriches events with roles associated with usernames or endpoints (Asset Roles)

xqlStages.name: iploc
xqlStages.description: Associates IPv4 addresses with geolocation attributes (City, Country, ASN, etc.)

xqlStages.name: join
xqlStages.description: Combines results of two queries
xqlStages.exampleUsage: join type=left (dataset=assets | fields ip, owner) as a a.ip = src_ip

xqlStages.name: limit
xqlStages.description: Sets the maximum number of records returned

xqlStages.name: replacenull
xqlStages.description: Replaces null values with a specified text string

xqlStages.name: search
xqlStages.description: Searches for free-text strings across datasets (limited to last 90 days)

xqlStages.name: sort
xqlStages.description: Orders the result set

xqlStages.name: target
xqlStages.description: Saves query results to a named dataset or lookup. Must be the last stage

xqlStages.name: top
xqlStages.description: Returns approximate count and percentage of top elements for a field

xqlStages.name: transaction
xqlStages.description: Finds transactions based on events meeting specific constraints (span, startswith, endswith)

xqlStages.name: union
xqlStages.description: Combines two result sets

xqlStages.name: view
xqlStages.syntax: view highlight ... | view graph type = <type> ... | view column order = default|populated
xqlStages.description: Configures display (highlighting, graphing, or column ordering)

xqlStages.name: windowcomp
xqlStages.description: Calculates statistics over a window (group) of rows for each row
xqlStages.exampleUsage: windowcomp row_number() by session_id sort _time as rn

xqlFunctions.name: add
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the sum of two numeric values

xqlFunctions.name: approx_count
xqlFunctions.description: Returns an approximate count of distinct values using HyperLogLog

xqlFunctions.name: approx_quantiles
xqlFunctions.description: Returns an approximate quantile value for a numeric field

xqlFunctions.name: approx_top
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the approximate top N most frequent values of a field

xqlFunctions.name: array_all
xqlFunctions.description: Returns true if all elements in the array satisfy the condition

xqlFunctions.name: array_any
xqlFunctions.description: Returns true if any element in the array satisfies the condition

xqlFunctions.name: arrayconcat
xqlFunctions.description: Concatenates two arrays into a single array

xqlFunctions.name: arraycreate
xqlFunctions.description: Creates an array from the given values

xqlFunctions.name: arraydistinct
xqlFunctions.description: Returns an array with duplicate elements removed

xqlFunctions.name: arrayfilter
xqlFunctions.description: Filters array elements keeping only those matching the condition

xqlFunctions.name: arrayindex
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the element at the specified zero-based index in the array

xqlFunctions.name: arrayindexof
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of a value in an array

xqlFunctions.name: array_length
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the number of elements in an array

xqlFunctions.name: arraymap
xqlFunctions.description: Applies an expression to each element of an array, returning a new array

xqlFunctions.name: arraymerge
xqlFunctions.description: Merges all values of a field across grouped records into a single array
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: comp arraymerge(src_ip) as all_sources by dst_ip

xqlFunctions.name: arrayrange
xqlFunctions.description: Creates an array of numbers from start to end with the specified step

xqlFunctions.name: arraystring
xqlFunctions.description: Joins array elements into a single string separated by the delimiter

xqlFunctions.name: avg
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the average value of a numeric field across grouped records

xqlFunctions.name: coalesce
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the first non-null value from the arguments

xqlFunctions.name: concat
xqlFunctions.description: Concatenates multiple strings together

xqlFunctions.name: convert_from_base_64
xqlFunctions.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string to its original value

xqlFunctions.name: count
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the number of records or non-null values of a field

xqlFunctions.name: count_distinct
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the count of distinct non-null values of a field

xqlFunctions.name: current_time
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the current timestamp at query execution time

xqlFunctions.name: date_floor
xqlFunctions.description: Rounds a timestamp down to the nearest specified time unit (day, hour, minute, etc.)

xqlFunctions.name: divide
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the result of dividing a by b

xqlFunctions.name: earliest
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the value of a field from the earliest record by time
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: comp earliest(action) as first_action by src_ip

xqlFunctions.name: extract_time
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts a component (YEAR, MONTH, DAY, HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND, DOW) from a timestamp

xqlFunctions.name: extract_url_host
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts the hostname from a URL string

xqlFunctions.name: extract_url_pub_suffix
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts the public suffix (e.g. .com, .co.uk) from a URL string

xqlFunctions.name: extract_url_registered_domain
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts the registered domain (e.g. example.com) from a URL string

xqlFunctions.name: first
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the first value of a field encountered in the group
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: comp first(agent_hostname) as hostname by src_ip

xqlFunctions.name: first_value
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the first value of a field in a window computation ordered set
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: windowcomp first_value(action) as first_action order by _time

xqlFunctions.name: floor
xqlFunctions.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer

xqlFunctions.name: format_string
xqlFunctions.description: Formats values into a string using printf-style format specifiers (%s, %d, %f)

xqlFunctions.name: format_timestamp
xqlFunctions.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using the specified date-time format pattern

xqlFunctions.name: if
xqlFunctions.description: Conditional expression returning one of two values based on a boolean condition

xqlFunctions.name: incidr
xqlFunctions.description: Checks whether an IPv4 address falls within a specified CIDR range

xqlFunctions.name: incidr6
xqlFunctions.description: Checks whether an IPv6 address falls within a specified IPv6 CIDR range

xqlFunctions.name: incidrlist
xqlFunctions.description: Checks whether an IP address falls within any of the specified CIDR ranges

xqlFunctions.name: int_to_ip
xqlFunctions.description: Converts an integer representation to an IPv4 address string

xqlFunctions.name: ip_to_int
xqlFunctions.description: Converts an IPv4 address string to its integer representation

xqlFunctions.name: is_ipv4
xqlFunctions.description: Returns true if the value is a valid IPv4 address

xqlFunctions.name: is_known_private_ipv4
xqlFunctions.description: Returns true if the IPv4 address belongs to a known private/reserved range (RFC 1918)

xqlFunctions.name: is_ipv6
xqlFunctions.description: Returns true if the value is a valid IPv6 address

xqlFunctions.name: is_known_private_ipv6
xqlFunctions.description: Returns true if the IPv6 address belongs to a known private/reserved range

xqlFunctions.name: json_extract
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts a value from a JSON string at the specified path (returns object)

xqlFunctions.name: json_extract_array
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts an array from a JSON string at the specified path

xqlFunctions.name: json_extract_scalar
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts a scalar value from a JSON string at the specified path

xqlFunctions.name: json_extract_scalar_array
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts an array of scalar values from a JSON string at the specified path

xqlFunctions.name: lag
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the value of a field from a previous row in a window computation
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: windowcomp lag(action, 1) as prev_action order by _time

xqlFunctions.name: last
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the last value of a field encountered in the group
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: comp last(agent_hostname) as latest_host by src_ip

xqlFunctions.name: last_value
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the last value of a field in a window computation ordered set
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: windowcomp last_value(action) as last_action order by _time

xqlFunctions.name: latest
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the value of a field from the most recent record by time
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: comp latest(action) as last_action by src_ip

xqlFunctions.name: len
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the length of a string or the number of elements in an array

xqlFunctions.name: list
xqlFunctions.description: Aggregates all values of a field into a list across grouped records
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: comp list(action) as all_actions by src_ip

xqlFunctions.name: lowercase
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a string to lower case

xqlFunctions.name: ltrim
xqlFunctions.description: Removes specified leading characters (or whitespace if not specified) from a string

xqlFunctions.name: rtrim
xqlFunctions.description: Removes specified trailing characters (or whitespace if not specified) from a string

xqlFunctions.name: trim
xqlFunctions.description: Removes specified leading and trailing characters (or whitespace if not specified) from a string

xqlFunctions.name: max
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the maximum value of a numeric field across grouped records

xqlFunctions.name: median
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the median value of a numeric field across grouped records

xqlFunctions.name: min
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the minimum value of a numeric field across grouped records

xqlFunctions.name: multiply
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the product of two numeric values

xqlFunctions.name: object_create
xqlFunctions.description: Creates a JSON object from key-value pairs

xqlFunctions.name: object_merge
xqlFunctions.description: Merges two JSON objects into a single object

xqlFunctions.name: parse_epoch
xqlFunctions.description: Converts an epoch value to a timestamp using the specified time unit (SECONDS, MILLIS, MICROS, NANOS)

xqlFunctions.name: parse_timestamp
xqlFunctions.description: Parses a string into a timestamp using the specified date-time format pattern

xqlFunctions.name: pow
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the value of base raised to the specified exponent

xqlFunctions.name: rank
xqlFunctions.description: Assigns a rank to each row in a window computation, with gaps for ties
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: windowcomp rank() as rnk order by score desc

xqlFunctions.name: regexcapture
xqlFunctions.description: Captures all named groups from a regex match and returns them as an object

xqlFunctions.name: regextract
xqlFunctions.description: Extracts the first capture group from a regex match

xqlFunctions.name: replace
xqlFunctions.description: Replaces the first occurrence of a literal pattern in a string

xqlFunctions.name: replex
xqlFunctions.description: Replaces all occurrences matching a regex pattern in a string

xqlFunctions.name: round
xqlFunctions.description: Rounds a number to the specified number of decimal places

xqlFunctions.name: row_number
xqlFunctions.description: Assigns a unique sequential number to each row in a window computation
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: windowcomp row_number() as rn order by _time

xqlFunctions.name: split
xqlFunctions.description: Splits a string into an array by the specified delimiter

xqlFunctions.name: stddev_population
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the population standard deviation of a numeric field

xqlFunctions.name: stddev_sample
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the sample standard deviation of a numeric field

xqlFunctions.name: string_count
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the number of occurrences of a substring within a string

xqlFunctions.name: subtract
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the result of subtracting b from a

xqlFunctions.name: sum
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the sum of a numeric field across grouped records

xqlFunctions.name: time_frame_end
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the end timestamp of the configured query timeframe

xqlFunctions.name: timestamp_diff
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the difference between two timestamps in the specified unit (SECOND, MINUTE, HOUR, DAY)

xqlFunctions.name: timestamp_seconds
xqlFunctions.description: Converts epoch seconds to a timestamp

xqlFunctions.name: to_boolean
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a value to boolean type

xqlFunctions.name: to_epoch
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a timestamp to an epoch value in the specified unit (SECONDS, MILLIS, MICROS, NANOS)

xqlFunctions.name: to_float
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a value to a floating-point number

xqlFunctions.name: to_integer
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a value to an integer

xqlFunctions.name: to_json_string
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a value (object, array, scalar) to its JSON string representation

xqlFunctions.name: to_number
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a value to a number type

xqlFunctions.name: to_string
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a value to a string type

xqlFunctions.name: to_timestamp
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a value to a timestamp using the given format

xqlFunctions.name: uppercase
xqlFunctions.description: Converts a string to upper case

xqlFunctions.name: values
xqlFunctions.description: Aggregates all distinct values of a field into an array across grouped records
xqlFunctions.exampleUsage: comp values(action) as unique_actions by src_ip

xqlFunctions.name: var
xqlFunctions.description: Returns the variance of a numeric field across grouped records
